definitions.explanation: A gathering held to see off someone who is departing — a transferring colleague, a graduating student, a person going abroad. Slightly more formal and celebratory in tone than {送別会|そうべつかい}, emphasizing well-wishing rather than parting.

examples.japanese: {歓送会|かんそうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
⟦{留学生|りゅうがくせい}→留学生：02986_ryuugakusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歓送会|かんそうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{招|まね}かれました→招く：02425_maneku⟧。
examples.english: I was invited to the send-off party for the exchange students.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歓送会|かんそうかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことになっている。
examples.english: At next week's send-off party, the department head is scheduled to give a speech.

notes:
From {歓送|かんそう} (giving a warm send-off) + ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (gathering). Typical of workplaces and schools at the spring transfer season, and often paired with a welcome party as ⟦{歓送迎会|かんそうげいかい}→歓送迎会：30247_kansougeikai⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歓送会|かんそうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold a send-off party
- {歓送会|かんそうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧: to attend a send-off party
- {歓送会|かんそうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{幹事|かんじ}→幹事：16378_kanji⟧: the organizer of a send-off party

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{送別会|そうべつかい}→送別会：16080_soubetsukai⟧: farewell party — the everyday word; interchangeable in most contexts but focuses on the parting
- ⟦{歓迎会|かんげいかい}→歓迎会：15791_kangeikai⟧: welcome party — the counterpart, held for new arrivals
